name: Devenish
text: Devenish is an island in Lough Erne in County Fermanagh. Its Irish name Daim Inis means ox island. Devenish held an early island monastery whose ruins still stand. The monastery belongs to the older monastic pattern of lake-island sites. Visitors reach it by boat across the lough. Ann Hamlin's study of the site remains the standard reference. Hamlin's book Devenish was published at Newry in 1979. The site lies in the part of Ulster now governed from Northern Ireland. Devenish stands as a working record of early Irish monastic life.
